expectations.text: A3 Machine and archive blocks are collapsed in details blocks and plain-headed, each opening with a line that names its bin (AI input or archive) and what it supports; long material sits in a sibling file behind a pointer

suggestions.reason: The assertion text omits the 500-2600 px width bound that rule D4 and the checker apply. This run's Figure 1 (2760 px) is readable-but-small at 800 px, so the verdict turned on a 160 px overshoot rather than on the reader's experience. State the bound in the assertion, or use a measurable criterion such as a minimum rendered font size (for example 9 px at 800 px).

Passes trivially when no glance panel exists: panel_words counts the prose of the first H2, so any document whose first section is short passes (here 239 words for 'The short version', sitting behind 20 lines of header). Pair it with C1 or measure from the title.

Compound of two checks (diagram within the first screen or two, and the Catalog-not-queue call-out). This run met the call-out but not the diagram, and the verdict hides which half failed. Split into two assertions.

Six sub-claims in one pass/fail. 'Edge list in the archive' cannot be met when the document has no archive, and 'takeaway' is subjective. Split D5 from D6 and define the minimum (for example, the caption contains a sentence stating the takeaway).

The universal clause ('content not in the inputs is labelled') is falsified by a single unlabelled addition (the 'By Friday' goals), yet a conscientious baseline like this one otherwise meets it. Test the specific planted ambiguities (attempts vs retries, POLICY_MODE default, CET) and the unknowns list instead; as written it barely separates skill from no-skill.

No assertion checks fidelity of the 20-row config table or other transcribed figures beyond retries and the 15-minute target. A wrong default would go uncaught; add a spot-check of at least five settings against architecture-notes.md.

Human-zone length (about 3,331 words against the 2,500 advisory, rule F2) and the 20-row inline table (rule A2) surface only inside the aggregate 'Automatic checks' count. Consider an explicit proportionality assertion for explainers.

eval_feedback.overall: Structural assertions (A1, A3, B1, C1, Mental model first) discriminate well: this competent no-skill run fails all of them. Content assertions (D1, D2, Concepts before flows, Week-one use, Figures) are met by a careful baseline, so they check correctness but do not separate skill from no-skill. Several compound assertions (D3 D4, D5 D6, Mental model first) hide which sub-claim decided the verdict.
